notes: Random owner lists (0..4 owners at 0x1d0000 with random kinds 0..6 and beyond, classes I/O/other, slot counts including 0, negative and up to 11, slot entries free/reserved/used) and node lists (0..60 nodes at 0x1d4000, mostly class 2 with node types drawn per case from the grouped types so that some types have more than eight nodes, some claimed, mode 1/2, foreign or half-matching keys); owners share one to three keys. 0xcc6c0 logs its three stack arguments and returns distinct buffers; 0xccdbc logs EAX, DL, BL, ECX and its five stack arguments and returns random request numbers with sign and upper-word patterns; 0xcc768 logs EAX. count_open_entries, the pair matchers and fill_bytes run as originals.
